card.title: ALAM EL HALFA
card.text: During the Battle of Alam el Halfa in 1942 the British forces halted a major Axis assault.
card.flavorText: The Battle of Alam el Halfa took place from August 30th to September 5th, 1942, near El Alamein in Egypt. German and Italian forces, led by General Erwin Rommel, attempted to break through British defenses to seize the Suez Canal. However, the British, under General Bernard Montgomery, anticipated the attack and established strong defensive positions on higher ground. Despite intense fighting, the British forces held their lines, forcing Rommel to retreat. This battle marked a turning point in the North African Campaign, as it was the last major offensive by Axis forces in the region.
